snippet.title: Once Upon A KATAMARI – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Announcement Trailer + Rolling LIVE Highlights DLC
snippet.description:
Once Upon A KATAMARI is joining Nintendo Switch 2 with mouse controls, smoother framerate, and HD graphics!

Then, keep the good times rolling with Rolling LIVE Highlights, a paid DLC with new cousins and quests!
